snippet.title: Legacy of Valor - Official Cinematic and Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the latest Legacy of Valor trailer for this upcoming story-driven medieval RPG blending open-world exploration, city-building strategy, and dynamic combat. Step into the world of Legacy of Valor in this new trailer and get a peek at gameplay. Legacy of Valor will be available on PC, and a Kickstarter campaign is coming soon.
